system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

The ability to rapidly recover has reached its peak within you. Once per turn, while in combat, when you would take damage from a hostile creature that wouldn’t reduce you to 0 hit points, you regain an amount of hit points equal to half your level.

Additionally, conditions with the [Persist] tag, now end after 1 minute has passed.
